title: Science Sparks
subject: Science
description: Big ideas. Tiny particles. A whole lot of discovery.

questions.prompt: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Iron oxide on its surface gives Mars its reddish colour.

questions.prompt: What do plants absorb from the atmosphere during photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants use carbon dioxide, water and light to make sugars.

questions.prompt: Which force keeps planets in orbit around the Sun?
questions.explanation: Gravity attracts objects with mass to each other.

questions.prompt: Which organ pumps blood around your body?
questions.explanation: The heart pumps blood through the circulatory system.

questions.prompt: What is the chemical formula for water?
questions.explanation: Each water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

questions.prompt: Which state of matter has a fixed volume but takes the shape of its container?
questions.explanation: Liquids flow to fit their containers while keeping roughly the same volume.

questions.prompt: What is the smallest unit of a living organism?
questions.explanation: Cells are the basic structural and functional units of life.

questions.prompt: Which material usually conducts electricity well?
questions.explanation: Copper has electrons that can move freely through the metal.

title: Number Rush
subject: Mathematics
description: Quick thinking meets a little mathematical magic.

questions.prompt: What is 12 × 8?
Which number is prime?
questions.explanation: 17 has exactly two positive divisors: 1 and 17.

questions.prompt: What is 25% of 200?
questions.explanation: 25% is one quarter. 200 ÷ 4 = 50.

questions.prompt: How many degrees are in the interior angles of a triangle?
questions.explanation: The interior angles of a triangle on a flat plane sum to 180°.

questions.prompt: What is the square root of 144?
Solve: 3x + 5 = 20
questions.explanation: Subtract 5 from both sides, then divide by 3.

questions.prompt: Which fraction equals 0.75?
questions.explanation: 75/100 simplifies to 3/4.

questions.prompt: What is the area of a rectangle 7 cm long and 4 cm wide?
questions.explanation: Area = length × width = 7 × 4 = 28 square centimetres.

title: World Explorer
subject: Geography
description: From oceans to capitals. Take your brain around the world.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra is Australia's national capital.

questions.prompt: Which ocean is the largest?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean by surface area.

questions.prompt: On which continent is Egypt?
questions.explanation: Most of Egypt is in northeastern Africa; the Sinai Peninsula is in Asia.

questions.prompt: Which country has Tokyo as its capital?
questions.explanation: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.

questions.prompt: Which imaginary line divides Earth into Northern and Southern Hemispheres?
questions.explanation: The Equator lies at 0° latitude.

questions.prompt: Which continent is home to the Amazon rainforest?
questions.explanation: The Amazon basin spans several countries in South America.

questions.prompt: Which country is shaped like a boot?
questions.explanation: Italy's peninsula is often described as boot-shaped.

questions.prompt: Which is the world's largest hot desert?
questions.explanation: The Sahara is the largest hot desert. Antarctica is the largest desert overall.
